environment.description: Same application deployed on EC2 behind ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached to the ALB with three rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with default action (priority 10), (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet with default action (priority 20), (3) A custom rule group 'query-string-entropy-filter' (priority 30) with a single regex rule matching request query string values against pattern `['";\-]{2,}|UNION\s|SELECT\s|DROP\s|INSERT\s|UPDATE\s|DELETE\s|OR\s+\d|AND\s+\d` with action BLOCK. WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics enabled for all rules. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to S3 with Athena queries scheduled every 5 minutes checking for 403 response spikes.

config.infrastructure: AWS WAFv2 WebACL -> ALB -> EC2 (Amazon Linux 2023)
